args.title: checkout-api health-check failures after v2.3.1 deployment; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api was unhealthy after the v2.3.1 deployment in us-east, us-west, and eu-west, with an observed error rate of 18%. Checked release history and identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rolled back checkout-api from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 across all three production regions. Rollback was verified, and a subsequent service status check confirmed v2.3.0 in every region, healthy service status, and an error rate of 0.2%.

trace.final:
Rolled back **checkout-api** from **v2.3.1 to v2.3.0**, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

Verified the service is healthy; error rate dropped from **18% to 0.2%**.

Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the rollback and verification, and paged the on-call engineer.

content.text:
Rolled back **checkout-api** from **v2.3.1 to v2.3.0**, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

Verified the service is healthy; error rate dropped from **18% to 0.2%**.

Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the rollback and verification, and paged the on-call engineer.
